evidence: Coupled normalized SDF improved Chamfer and normals while increasing Gaussian count from about 10.6k to 14.3k. Detached SDF/UDF did not reproduce that gain, and UDF collapsed to a near-constant field.
goal: Separate implicit-field geometry effects from field-gradient-driven adaptive splitting, then match Gaussian count with no-field controls.

variants.sdf_total_control: legacy coupled SDF using total-loss adaptive gradients
variants.sdf_image_grad: same SDF but adaptive split statistics use image loss only
variants.nofield_control: no implicit field at the original split threshold
variants.nofield_split_4e5: no field with a moderately lower split threshold
variants.nofield_split_3e5: no field with a lower split threshold to approach the SDF Gaussian count
variants.sdf_image_split_4e5: image-gradient SDF with moderate split threshold compensation
variants.sdf_image_split_3e5: image-gradient SDF with stronger split threshold compensation

fixed: Complete K4 preset, 240 training views, seed 42, 12k, four stages, all geometry/support/scattering settings unchanged except named variables.
parallel_policy: Seven submitted, maximum six simultaneous for 12GB VRAM safety.
robustness_policy: Incomplete K5-test3 and K9-test7 manifests are used only for final evaluation after all seven training runs finish.
